description: Upload one picture or video to attach to drafts: PNG, JPEG, WebP or MP4, up to 10 MB. Answers its media id. A file that no draft uses is removed 24 hours after upload. Only for small files you already hold as base64: for a picture or video you made yourself, use media_upload_link, which is far quicker than writing the file out. Make a picture a JPEG: every network that takes pictures accepts JPEG, while Instagram refuses PNG and WebP (capabilities lists each network’s mediaTypes).

alt.description: What the picture shows, for people who cannot see it. Kept with the file.

base64.description: The file’s bytes in standard base64, with no data: prefix. Up to 10 MB of file.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

mimeType.description: The file’s real format. A file whose bytes do not match is refused.

name.description: The file name, for the user’s own list.

name: media_upload
title: Upload a photo or video
